Package com.noorlandmc.NoorCore.bridge

Interface MenuServiceBridge

All Superinterfaces:
Service
All Known Implementing Classes:
NoorMenuServiceBridgeImpl
public interface MenuServiceBridge extends Service
Service bridge for accessing custom menu constructors from NoorMenus.

Provides methods to query and validate custom entities.
